description: Angular component for a map timeline panel with playback controls, time range management, and timestamp formatting.

classes.name: MapTimelinePanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a timeline panel with playback and navigation features for map widgets.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes timestamp format and playback speed.

methods.name: onIndexChange
methods.description: Handles manual index change and updates current time.

methods.name: moveNext
methods.description: Advances to next time point, optionally snapping to real location.

methods.name: movePrev
methods.description: Moves to previous time point, optionally snapping to real location.

methods.name: speedUpdated
methods.description: Updates playback speed and restarts playback if active.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts layout based on panel width.

methods.name: updateCurrentTime
methods.description: Calculates and sets current time based on index.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds index in array closest to a value.
